events.description: We’re back for night two at Cobalt Lounge inside Black Bear Casino Resort on Saturday, October 17 from 9 PM to midnight. Saturday nights at Black Bear always have their own kind of electricity, and we plan to lean all the way into it. Expect a high-energy night filled with the songs you know, the songs you forgot you loved, and the kind of live set that keeps the room moving from the first note to last call. Black Bear has been very good to us, and every chance we get to return to this stage means a lot.

events.description: The Greenway Amateur Hockey Association is hosting a Halloween Fun Run on October 24th at 4:30 pm. Registration will begin after school. There will be a 5k and a shorter options for the goblins who do not want to go as far. The race will start and end at the Hodgins-Berardo Arena in Coleraine. Please wear a costume if you would like or your favorite Greenway jersey!! $20 Entry Fee- T shirt included while supplies last $50 Immediate Family Entry Fee 3:30 PM- Registration at Hodgins-Berardo Area. You will pay for the race at this time.

events.title: Indecent Proposal
events.description: Indecent Proposal is coming back to Mr. D’s Bar & Grill in Duluth, MN on Saturday, November 21st from 8 PM–midnight. It has been a while since we’ve hit the Mr. D’s stage, and we’re ready to bring the full night back with your favorite covers, originals, loud guitars, and plenty of Indecent energy. Grab your crew, settle in, and spend the night with us at Mr. D’s. Come out and get Indecent 😈😎🎸🤘💜 www.indyp218.com Indecent Proposal is a band out of Duluth, Minnesota, built around connection, feel, and songs that hold up in a room full of people.

events.description: “ONE OF THE MOST REMARKABLE SHOWS IN MUSICAL THEATRE HISTORY” The Washington Post A letter that was never meant to be seen, a lie that was never meant to be told, a life he never dreamed he could have. From the Tony, Oscar and Golden Globe-winning songwriting team Ben Pasek and Justin Paul (The Greatest Showman, La La Land), DEAR EVAN HANSEN is a new musical about life and the way we live it. Opening in November 2019. Book your tickets today.
